remarks:
Wake up to panoramic golf course and Silver Lake views in this beautifully updated home, perfectly positioned along the first fairway of an 18-hole championship golf course. Offering an exceptional combination of comfort, outdoor living, and an unbeatable location, this property is ready for its next owner.

The thoughtfully designed interior features an open floor plan filled with natural light, creating an inviting space for both relaxing and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, modern appliances, and ample cabinetry, flowing seamlessly into the dining and living areas.

The home offers two spacious bedrooms, including a private primary suite with its own full bath, along with an additional full bathroom to accommodate family and guests. Recent improvements include fresh interior paint, new vinyl and stone siding, a welcoming front porch, professional landscaping, and a new blacktop driveway, giving the home outstanding curb appeal.

Step outside and experience one of the property's most impressive features. The upper deck captures spectacular golf course and lake views, while the lower stamped concrete patio and custom-built outdoor wet bar create the perfect setting for entertaining, summer barbecues, or simply unwinding after a day on the course.

Located just minutes from restaurants, shopping, boating, fishing, hiking, and all that the Silver Lake area has to offer, this home delivers the ideal balance of peaceful surroundings and everyday convenience. Whether you're searching for a year-round residence or the perfect getaway, this is a rare opportunity to own a home in one of the area's most desirable locations.
